in_marathi.name: Arjita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjita is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arjita’, meaning precious, valuable, or conquered. In Hindu mythology, Arjita is a popular name for girls, inspired by the hero Arjuna from the Mahabharata.
